model.name: Tiny Stories v2 (big BPE, T=256)
model.description: TinyStories rerun: same C=256/L=4 as 256-8-4-4 but bpe_merges=4000 and max_len=256 to fix the context/tokenizer bottleneck. ~3.9M params with tied embeddings.

metadata.description: v2 recipe after 256-8-4-4 plateaued at loss ~1.29: bigger vocab (4000 merges, ~4k tokens) so 256-token context holds a full short story; cosine decay to 0.1 instead of flat LR.
